liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Only part of Dark Star was played, but the band followed the music into deep territory; Reviewer likes the Dark Star despite it being only half-length [22][27]
- **Big Boss Man** (1 review): Reviewer enjoyed the Big Boss Man and Goin' Down The Road versions in a short show [27]
- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Vocals are somewhat sloppy at times in Shakedown Street, but Jerry's playing in Shakedown, Iko and Dark Star pleases [28]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd89-12-31 s1t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd89-12-31 s1t02 Sugar Magnolia**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd89-12-31 s1t03 Touch Of Grey**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd89-12-31 s1t04 Man Smart (Woman Smarter)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd89-12-31 s1t05 Big Boss Man**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd89-12-31 s1t06 Stuck Inside Of Mobile With The Memphis Blues Again**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd89-12-31 s1t07 Shakedown Street**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]
- **gd89-12-31 s2t01 Midnight Countdown**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [31]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-12-31.142693.fob.bk4011.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 173 min [1]
- **gd1989-12-31.165046.mtx.seamons.ht161.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 169 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1989-12-31.sbd.gillis.gorinsky.6116.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1989-12-31.155442.UltraMatrix.sbd.broadcast-mix.cm.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 166 min [4]. Said about its sound: The mix shifts throughout, with the ambient microphone often turned off [4]
- **gd89-12-31.prefm.miller.23574.sbeok.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 3.56/5 by 9 [8]. Said about its sound: Recording levels run high with heavy clipping, making the Sunshine Daydream nearly unusable; Sound quality is imperfect, though acceptable; Recording has distortion from overloaded levels; listener wonders whether EQ can reduce it [19][22][23][26]
- **gd89-12-31.sbd.bertha-ashley.18674.sbeok.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 20 songs; 153 min; rated 3.5/5 by 14 [13]. Said about its sound: Sound is good but not great; the Coliseum's room acoustics are audible [21]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's first New Year's show; felt like a flawless evening. Mickey used a strange echoing percussion effect throughout [21]
- Bonnie Raitt joined the band for Big Boss Man [1]
- Taro Hart guested on Iko Iko; Airto Moreira joined from Victim through Drums; Bonnie Raitt on Big Boss Man [2]
- Midnight Hour was effectively a second encore; Bonnie Raitt guested during the show [3]
- Bonnie Raitt sat in on Big Boss Man [4]
- The previous year the band opened the second set with this year's first three songs [21]
- Fans hoped for rarities after summer and fall revivals of old tunes, but only Dark Star appeared during this run [25]
- Playing Iko Iko on two nights of the run is unusual [27]
- Reviewer notes the 12-28-89 show is missing from the collection of this New Year's run [30]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-12-31.142693.fob.bk4011.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Master (FOB)Audience Dat; B&K 4011 mics (ORTF, 110 degrees)(16-bit/48k); Transfer Info: Dat (Sony PCM-R500)> Tascam DA-3000… [1]
- **gd1989-12-31.165046.mtx.seamons.ht161.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) July… [2]. Also: Matrix of soundboard and audience; a murky 10-second soundboard patch in Sugar Magnolia was removed, with audience-only audio there; Midnight Countdown comes from the broadcast mix: audience feed with radio announcers talking over it [2]
- **gd1989-12-31.sbd.gillis.gorinsky.6116.shnf**: taped by Glenn Gillis; transferred by G. Gorinsky; source: FMS > DAT > CDR > EAC (secure mode, test and copy) > SHN [3]
- **gd1989-12-31.155442.UltraMatrix.sbd.broadcast-mix.cm.miller.t.flac16**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 28, 2021; source: UltraMatrix SBD (Broadcast Mix) > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [4]. Also: UltraMatrix broadcast mix assembled from multiple masters to complete the show [4]
- **gd89-12-31.prefm.miller.23574.sbeok.shnf**: source: Pre-FM -> Dat -> Samplitude -> CD -> EAC -> SHN [8]
- **gd89-12-31.sbd.bertha-ashley.18674.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>>PreFM>>DAT>>CDA>>WAV(EAC)>>SHN>>DAW(Bertha)>>CDA/SHN [13]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - December 31, 1989](https://www.dead.net/show/december-31-1989) [35]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1989-12-31 Grateful Dead Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1989-12-31-grateful-dead-ticket/) [36]

Sound quality is imperfect, though acceptable
Recording has distortion from overloaded levels; listener wonders whether EQ can reduce it
Fans hoped for rarities after summer and fall revivals of old tunes, but only Dark Star appeared during this run
Miller's version runs at a slightly higher bitrate than the other, with louder, crisper volume
Reviewer enjoyed the Big Boss Man and Goin' Down The Road versions in a short show
Playing Iko Iko on two nights of the run is unusual
Reviewer likes the Dark Star despite it being only half-length
Vocals are somewhat sloppy at times in Shakedown Street, but Jerry's playing in Shakedown, Iko and Dark Star pleases
Reviewer notes the 12-28-89 show is missing from the collection of this New Year's run
Bonnie Raitt joined the band for Big Boss Man
Ted Mattes's DAT, transferred by Charlie Miller; a matrix source patches 1:31 of Man Smart (Woman Smarter)
Taro Hart guested on Iko Iko; Airto Moreira joined from Victim through Drums; Bonnie Raitt on Big Boss Man
Matrix of soundboard and audience; a murky 10-second soundboard patch in Sugar Magnolia was removed, with audience-only audio there
Midnight Countdown comes from the broadcast mix: audience feed with radio announcers talking over it
Midnight Hour was effectively a second encore; Bonnie Raitt guested during the show
Glenn Gillis's source; SHN extraction and seeding done by G. Gorinsky
The mix shifts throughout, with the ambient microphone often turned off
UltraMatrix broadcast mix assembled from multiple masters to complete the show
Bonnie Raitt sat in on Big Boss Man
